source.Name: Total population
source.Summary: Population: Total population and distribution by age and sex estimated to be  consistent with the population by age and sex of the (a) 1960-1961 Census  (Libreville) and 1969-1970, 1993, 2003 censuses; (b) adjusted censuses for  underenumeration; (c) official estimates through 2005; (d) only total  population for 2013 Census; and with estimates of the subsequent trends in  fertility, mortality and international migration.

source.Name: Total fertility rate
source.Summary: Fertility: Total fertility rate and age pattern of fertility based on: (a) official  estimates of age-specific fertility rates through 2000; (b) birth-histories  data from the 2000, 2012 DHS; (c) births in the household in the preceding  12 (or 24) months classified by age of mother from the 1960-1961 Census  (Libreville) and 1960-1961 DS and 1993 Census; (d) indirect estimates  obtained from the application of the reverse survival method to the  1960-1961 Census (Libreville) and 1969-1970, 1993 censuses and 2005 EGESP;  (e) cohort-completed fertility backdated by the mean age of childbearing  from the 1993 Census and 2000, 2012 DHS.

source.Name: Life expectancy at birth
source.Summary: Overall Mortality: Life expectancy at birth and age pattern of mortality based on: (a) The demographic impact of AIDS has been factored into the mortality estimates; (b) estimates using HIV/AIDS model life tables and estimates of under-five  mortality (5q0) and adult mortality (45q15) with UNAIDS estimates of adult  HIV prevalence, and ART coverage for children and adults.  Mortality rates for Spectrum were calculated by deducting AIDS-related mortality

source.Name: Age Mortality
source.Summary: Adult and Old Age Mortality: Estimates derived from: (a) recent household deaths data by age and sex  from the 1960-1961 Census (Libreville); (b) siblings deaths from the 2000,  2012 DHS; (c) International estimates considered up to 2017.

source.Name: Infant/child mortality
source.Summary: Child Mortality: Under-five mortality based on: (a) direct estimates from births and deaths under-five calculated from full birth histories data from the 2000, 2012  DHS; (b) indirect estimates from data on children ever born and surviving  from the 1960-1961 Census (Libreville) and 1980, 1993, 2003 censuses; (c)  recent household deaths from the 1960-1961 Census (Libreville) and 1980,  2003 censuses; (d) International estimates used up to 2018.

source.Name: International migration
source.Summary: Migration: International migration based on: (a) information on foreign-born  populations from censuses and registers from major countries of  destination; (b) estimates derived as the differences between overall  population growth and natural increase; (c) UNHCR statistics on the number  of refugees in the main countries of asylum.
